content.comment_body: Hello, I've programmed a [product_name] that switches outputs using a pulse generator, and I use a data log to track output states. Before running the program, I manually set the pulse generator parameters (TH and TL), and this works as expected. Main question: I'd like the data log to record TH and TL in each entry, but it seems those parameters can't be directly added to the data log. Is it in general possible to include such parameters in the data log? (I’m aware TH and TL could be measured manually, but that’s not practical.) Secondary questions: - Would it be possible for the data log to have a header for parameters that remain unchanged during program execution? I believe this isn't natively supported, but does anyone know a way to add a header? - Is there other software or programming language that provides better data logging features with [product_name] than [product_name]Soft Comfort? Used hardware and software: - [company_name] [product_name] 230RCE; Product Number: [article_no] - [product_name]Soft Comfort [version_no] Thank you

It would be useful if the data log could record TH and TL in every entry. Do TH and TL originate from an asynchronous pulse block? If so, you can use a NAND (Edge) and an AND (Edge), and connect them to the output of your pulse-generating block for the data log. Then, use an OR function to create pulses for the data log entries.

Hello, I've attached an example showing how to record parameters that are not typically supported by the data log configuration in [product_name]. Regarding your request for a log header: while that would be convenient, keep in mind that a [product_name] has many features for its low cost. A dedicated data logger provides more comprehensive recording capabilities, but also comes at a much higher price point. Everyone wishes for premium features at low prices – like a luxury car for a bargain! Unfortunately, products tend to be priced according to their functionality. Best regards, [user_name]
Thank you both for your prompt responses. @ [user_name]: I integrated your example into my program, and it works flawlessly.

analysis.insight_summary: Users working with [product_name]Soft Comfort [version_no] and [product_name] 230RCE are looking for more advanced data logging features. Specifically, they want to automatically record parameter values (such as TH and TL) in each log entry and have the option to add headers for parameters that do not change during program execution. Current data logging in these products does not natively support these features, prompting users to look for alternative methods or more flexible solutions. Some users suggested functional workarounds and shared examples, but overall, they acknowledge that data logging limitations are typical for the product's category and price.
analysis.user_expectations: The user would like to log parameter values automatically in every data log entry and optionally add a configurable header for static parameters. They are seeking advanced data logging options to make the use of [product_name]Soft Comfort more flexible and informative.
